fields.issue: Eq 3 floors at 0.45, so kd 0.3 has no lambda_I = 1 amplitude. The worst-width curve is pinned only at its plateau 0.2338 and by the one-thickness statement, kd about 0.20-0.25 at delta equal to t. kd 0.3 sits on the unretrieved rising branch between those pins. No pair is interpolated. The aluminium-honeycomb beryllium point has R/t_eq 136.7, inside the fit range 100-1550, so the missing amplitude is the floor, not the range. P2-E at R/t_eq 50.75 remains outside that range.
fields.consequence: The kd 0.3 row is a ceiling: below 197.052 mm on P2-E, below 73.17 mm on the 014b beryllium point, below 39.05 mm on 014 beryllium with HRH-10. The true allowance is smaller, and the gap factor against manufacture is not known.
fields.next: Digitise the worst-width envelope (Lee et al. 2016, or a recomputation) at delta/t below 1.
